rationale: Both candidates independently rediscover the one ground-truth issue still live in this diff (the serve-path default rel_l1_thresh=0.2 silently overriding the documented 0.17), and both correctly confirm the partition-gating concern from the ground truth is already resolved in this snapshot. Y goes further with actual traced runtime evidence for the threshold bug, a rigorous numeric analysis of the calibration polynomial's near-constant/non-monotone behavior, plus concrete, well-grounded findings on memory retention, wasted RoPE computation, and two specific test-coverage weaknesses (E2E can't detect zero cache hits; the cache-hit test can't catch stale t_emb). Both provide file:line actionable fixes, but Y's are more numerous and more concretely tied to verified evidence.
